statements.quote: As AI usage in our products and businesses continues to ramp, we continue to invest aggressively in infrastructure to meet the demand.
statements.notes: The sentence uses present tense and names no year, so it defaults to the reported year. It ties infrastructure investment to AI demand but gives no amount.

statements.quote: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $130-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $125-145 billion.
statements.notes: This is the company's total capex guidance, including finance lease principal, not the AI part. The sentence itself does not name AI. AI context comes only from p01 and p06, so it is recorded as total to keep it from being read as AI spend.

statements.quote: Year-over-year growth was primarily driven by increases in employee compensation, infrastructure costs, legal-related costs, and third-party AI token costs.
statements.notes: Q2 growth in total expenses is attributed partly to third-party AI token costs and infrastructure costs. No year is named; the period is Q2 of the reported year.

statements.quote: Excluding the previously mentioned severance expense, growth in employee compensation was driven by technical hires we’ve added over the past year, particularly AI talent.
statements.notes: Growth in headcount cost is attributed mainly to AI talent, with no amount given.

statements.quote: Within our Reality Labs segment, Q2 revenue was $431 million, up 16% year -over-year due to strong growth in AI glasses revenue, partially offset by lower Quest headset sales.
statements.notes: The $431 million is total Reality Labs segment revenue, not AI glasses revenue, so no AI amount is recorded. The sentence only says AI glasses revenue drove the segment's growth.

statements.quote: Our AI-powered Advantage+ end-to-end solutions continued to grow, reaching over $75 billion in annual revenue run-rate this quarter.
statements.notes: 'Over $75 billion' is recorded as a floor. It is an annualized run-rate, not reported fiscal-year revenue. It is advertising revenue flowing through AI-powered ad tools, not revenue from selling AI, so treat it with caution.
